field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this proxy gateway connection.

field.label: Name
field.help: Unique name for this connection (alphanumeric, max 16 chars). Used as interface suffix: pgw_<name>

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional description for this connection.

field.label: Proxy Server Interface
field.help: Select the OPNsense interface through which the proxy server is reachable. For a Tailscale SOCKS5 proxy on LAN2, select LAN2. This prevents routing loops.

field.label: Type
field.help: Upstream proxy protocol type.

field.label: Server
field.help: Hostname or IP address of the upstream proxy server.

field.label: Port
field.help: Port number of the upstream proxy server.

field.label: Authentication
field.help: Enable proxy authentication.

field.label: Username
field.help: Proxy authentication username.

field.label: Password
field.help: Proxy authentication password.

field.label: Encryption Method
field.help: Shadowsocks encryption method (AEAD ciphers only).

field.label: Shadowsocks Password
field.help: Shadowsocks encryption password. This is NOT proxy auth — it's the SS shared secret.

field.label: Obfuscation
field.help: Optional traffic obfuscation plugin (simple-obfs).

field.label: Obfuscation Host
field.help: Hostname for obfuscation (used as Host header for HTTP obfs or SNI for TLS obfs).

field.label: Private Key File
field.help: Path to SSH private key file on the OPNsense filesystem (e.g., /root/.ssh/id_ed25519). Leave empty to use password authentication.

field.label: Tunnel Address
field.help: Local IPv4 address for the tunnel interface. Leave empty for auto-assignment from the 172.31.0.0/16 range.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the tunnel (1280-9000, default 1500).

field.label: Enable Health Check
field.help: Run a connectivity probe through the proxy after starting this connection.

field.label: Target URL
field.help: URL to probe for health checks. Must return HTTP 200/204. Leave empty for default (http://1.1.1.1/).

field.label: Gateway Priority
field.help: Gateway priority for routing (1=highest, 255=lowest).

field.label: Test URL
field.help: Direct-download URL for speed tests. Must return a binary file (not HTML). Examples: http://speedtest.tele2.net/10MB.zip, https://proof.ovh.net/files/10Mb.dat, http://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/ubuntu-releases/ls-lR.gz — Default: Tele2 10MB download.

field.label: Enable Backup Proxy
field.help: Configure a backup proxy that will be used automatically when the primary proxy fails. Requires Health Check to be enabled.

field.label: Backup Type
field.help: Backup proxy protocol type.

field.label: Backup Server
field.help: Hostname or IP address of the backup proxy server.

field.label: Backup Port
field.help: Port number of the backup proxy server.

field.label: Backup Authentication
field.help: Enable authentication for the backup proxy.

field.label: Backup Username
field.help: Backup proxy authentication username.

field.label: Backup Password
field.help: Backup proxy authentication password.

field.label: Backup SS Method
field.help: Backup Shadowsocks encryption method.

field.label: Backup SS Password
field.help: Backup Shadowsocks encryption password.

field.label: Backup SSH Key File
field.help: Path to SSH private key file for the backup proxy.

field.label: Failover Threshold
field.help: Number of consecutive health check failures before switching to the backup proxy (1-10).

field.label: Auto Failback
field.help: Automatically switch back to the primary proxy when it recovers. The primary is probed directly; after 2 consecutive successes (with a 5-minute cooldown), traffic switches back.
